tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: The signed-in account holder's own 21-framework profile.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: List the user's saved people; optional name or email search.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Full 21-framework read for one person by profile_id, email, or name.

tools.name: create_profile
tools.description: Add a person, with optional known traits.

tools.name: list_relationships
tools.description: List saved pairings and the context each was scored in.

tools.name: score_compatibility
tools.description: Score two people for a business, romantic, friendship, or co-parenting context.

tools.name: generate_narrative
tools.description: Premium: write a plain-language coaching narrative for one person or a pair, synthesized from all 21 frameworks. Billed at 5x a normal tool call.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "list_relationships" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_profiles, get_profile · Public sink: list_profiles, get_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_profiles, get_profile · Public sink: list_profiles, get_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
